title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

errors: A line, struck by Grothendieck himself, claimed that R_{ρ,σ} no longer commutes with SG. He corrected this immediately: R = Ker Θ̃ is central relative to SG.
Grothendieck first wrote R_{ρ,σ}^{+} in (100) and corrected it to R°; he also corrected SG to 𝔊^+ there. These are self-corrected slips; no substantive error remains.

ideas.what: M^+ splits as a direct product SR × SG, with SR ≅ S'T_ρ × SN'_σ. This is a canonical complement to SL_2 inside the kernel of χ.
ideas.modern_name: Direct-product decomposition of a reductive group scheme: a centralizer complement to a normal semisimple factor
ideas.usually_credited_to: standard structure theory of reductive groups (Borel, Demazure–Grothendieck SGA3)

ideas.what: M ≅ (R × SG)/μ_2. M is the central product of R = Ker(M → PGL_2) with SL_2 along the diagonal μ_2.
ideas.modern_name: Central product / isogeny decomposition (e.g. GL_2 = (G_m × SL_2)/μ_2)

ideas.what: R_{ρ,σ} → T_{ρ,σ} is an isogeny, so M is, up to isogeny, a split extension of T_{ρ,σ} by SG.
ideas.modern_name: Splitting of an extension up to isogeny

deep.surprise_reason: The page carries out routine structure theory (direct and central product decompositions involving SL_2 and tori) for auxiliary groups within the unpublished loop-equation notes. It is internally useful but contains nothing a specialist would find new.
transcription_corrections: Line 1–3: the recurring 'm̄' should read 'même'. The passage reads: 'lié de façon beaucoup plus naturelle à la structure même des groupes M_{ρ,σ} et à ses homomorphismes Θ dans G et χ = det∘Θ dans G_m, savoir le sous-groupe section SR_{ρ,σ}, permettant d'écrire même M^+_{ρ,σ} comme un produit direct'.
'que R_{ρ,σ} → T_{ρ,σ} soit un isomorphisme' should read 'soit une isogénie' (underlined in the image).

'n'est [?] pas autre que l'on a, à cette région [?] pris' should read roughly 'ne veut dire autre chose que l'on a, à cette isogénie près, une "section" de M_{ρ,σ} lui-même en tant qu'extension de T_{ρ,σ} par 𝔊^+_{ρ,σ} ≅ SG'.
(101): 'R_{ρ,σ} ∩ SG = 1' should read 'R_{ρ,σ} ∩ SG = μ_2'. This is consistent with the previous page and with the kernel μ_2 in (102).
In (99) the bottom-left entry is S'T_ρ × SN'_σ, matching (98).
